name: ContentRemixer Brand Kit
concept: The crossfader IS the product — blog lines (left channel) + play button (right channel), knob mid-mix. Create once. Publish everywhere.

bg-1.role: tile gradient top / ink on light

wordmark.note: embedded as vector outlines in all SVGs — no runtime font dependency

clear_space.rule: Keep padding of at least 1 knob-width on all sides of the lockup.
clear_space.note: Knob = 44px on the 512 master canvas (≈8.6% of mark width).

min_size.note: Below 32px use favicon_min (fader + knob only — glyphs dropped).

corner_radius.scale: single rx scale, do not mix

effects.glow: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 6 (2 at favicon sizes) + feMerge
